components.note: Public documentation, repository checker, unit tests and CI configuration; not FPGA verification.

XC7Z100 JTAG, a vendor LED smoke test, diagnostic GE ARP receive/reply, and two direct camera-bitstream ARP replies after power cycles were observed. Physical package/speed grade, full board bring-up and independent reproduction remain open.

A vendor OV5640 bitstream replied to ARP directly after two power cycles. One 300-second run assembled 7884 complete 640x480 frames; a second 10-second run assembled 262. Earlier ARP startup failure remains unexplained. Formal frame quality, own PL processing and independent reproduction remain open.

A candidate RGB565 red-pixel count, box and centroid reference is implemented and checked on six synthetic scenes plus boundaries. Thresholds are not camera-calibrated; no PL comparison or board validation has been done.
